status: FROZEN once frozen_manifest_v6.json is committed. S2 implementation only; no market evaluation. All numbers are PROVISIONAL engineering assumptions, not validated optima.
extends: protocol.json (T1-T10 unchanged), protocol_v4_stats.json, protocol_v5_family_a.json (Family A stays rejected)

definitions.E: mark-to-market liquidation equity at the previous close
definitions.H: all-time high-water mark: running maximum of E, never reset (not by recovery, restart or authorisation)
definitions.P: epoch-local peak (P=H in epoch 0; E at an authorised restart, then running maximum)
definitions.allowed_exposure: X_open + (R - phi*X_open)/(phi + entry_cost) if phi*X_open <= R else R/phi
definitions.note: tier thresholds are boundaries of a control rule, NOT guaranteed maximum losses: gaps and missing liquidity can breach every floor and are reported as overshoot

precedence: SHUTDOWN absorbing (exit only through manual authorisation)
tier3_guard: epoch 0: floor = H*(1-tier3_dd). After an authorisation the tier-3 drawdown rule is replaced by the epoch floor (E_auth*(1-loss_limit), never below H*(1-hard_dd)) so authorised re-entry cannot be re-triggered immediately, while the hard limit and the never-reset HWM keep the cumulative protection

authorisation.checks: id match; approver non-empty; cap in (0,1]; loss limit in (0, epoch_loss_cap]; timezone-aware issued_at between the shutdown time and now, not older than approval_max_age_hours; approval_id not consumed; positions flat; equity above H*(1-hard_dd); state_integrity shutdowns cannot be authorised
authorisation.on_success: new epoch, REENTRY, HWM unchanged, SAFETY_DISQUALIFIED unchanged

safety_disqualified: set on every entry into SHUTDOWN, never cleared, independent of T4 (T4 is computed from equity only, exactly as in protocol.json)
persistence: atomic single file (write, fsync, os.replace): hash-chained transition records plus the latest state under one head hash; missing/unreadable/modified file on resume = SHUTDOWN(state_integrity); optional external anchor detects rollback or a recomputed-hash edit; the hash chain alone is tamper EVIDENCE, not prevention

statistics.trading_window: start to the last day with a position, trade or non-zero return
statistics.invested_days: days with a position held, a trade or a non-zero return
statistics.rule: report both; power on the window and, as the conservative bound, on invested days; effective n never above raw n
